<!-- Generated by website/scripts/extract.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Decoy `1.0.0`, corpus `62.0.0`. Every sample below was produced by
running that build — the values move with the corpus version, so a different corpus gives
different rows for the same seed.

319 generators across 29 namespaces. Each page lists every method with
output the library actually produced.

```swift
import Decoy
import DecoyLocaleEN

var faker = Faker(seed: 1337, locale: DecoyLocaleEN.locale)
faker.person.fullName()      // "Riley Bonneau"
faker.location.city()        // "Duchesne"
```
